entries.title: Huge crowds in Mashhad as Iran's late supreme leader is buried
entries.snippet: Ali Khamenei was buried at the Imam Reza shrine, Iran's holiest Shia Muslim site, ending six days of public mourning ceremonies.

entries.title: Ukrainian agent accused of murdering Monaco bomb suspect changes story

entries.snippet: Migrants deported from the U.S. and detained in a hotel in Equatorial Guinea say that authorities there also have used the facility to quarantine at least one suspected Ebola patient, deportees and lawyers representing them said Thursday.

entries.title: 8 men indicted on conspiracy charges over planned attack on White House UFC event
entries.snippet: Eight men were indicted on murder and terrorism conspiracy charges Thursday for their alleged roles in a thwarted drone and sniper attack on the UFC cage-fighting show staged at the White House in June.

entries.title: Wally Funk, aviation pioneer who was oldest woman to travel into space, dies at 87
entries.snippet: Funk was one of 13 female pilots who went through the same tests as NASA's all-male astronaut corps in the early 1960s but never made it into space. In 2021, she got her chance aboard Amazon founder Jeff Bezos' Blue Origin rocket.

entries.title: Judge dismisses suit challenging Sen. Tuberville's eligibility to run for Alabama governor
entries.snippet: A judge on Thursday dismissed a lawsuit alleging U.S. Sen. Tommy Tuberville does not meet the residency requirement to run for governor of Alabama.

entries.title: New attacks raise questions about what comes next in the Iran war
entries.snippet: Whether it is a negotiation tactic or a signal of an escalation in fighting, mediators are scrambling to save the interim deal and the actions risk further inflaming tensions.

entries.title: WATCH: White House columns appear to be Trump's latest project
entries.snippet: Crews have draped tarps over the towering stone columns on the north side of the White House, where work is underway to scrape away decades of paint.

entries.title: Mexico to seek criminal charges over deaths linked to ICE after fatal shooting of Houston man
entries.snippet: Mexican Foreign Minister Roberto Velasco's announcement Thursday morning further escalated tensions with the United States, as Mexico's government has sharply criticized the treatment of its citizens under U.S. President Donald Trump's push to increase deportations.

entries.title: South Florida's Palm Beach airport renamed President Donald J. Trump International
entries.snippet: Signs for the Palm Beach International Airport have been removed, while new signage goes up.

entries.title: Democratic socialist Francesca Hong tests how far left voters will go in battleground Wisconsin

entries.title: China retrieves booster in reusable rocket breakthrough
entries.snippet: China has joined the small group of space powers that can now recover an orbital-class booster rocket. Developers of the landing method turned to a striking alternative to that used by existing players such as SpaceX.

entries.title: Vegan pregnancy tests and other eco wins this week
entries.snippet: Keeping cool in the heat with a millennia-old tradition in India, a German company making animal-free medical tests, and building from bottles in Mozambique.

entries.title: Why the World Cup can be good for your mental health
entries.snippet: The World Cup can offer more than just entertainment, it can also benefit your mental well-being. DW explains why.

entries.title: Germany: Bundestag passes controversial healthcare reform
entries.snippet: The cost-cutting package passed Germany's lower house, with protests against it expected to take place. Elsewhere, Foreign Minister Johann Wadephul will meet his Slovenian counterpart in Berlin. Follow DW for more.

entries.title: Germany's richest man takes on Big Tech
entries.snippet: Dieter Schwarz made his fortune from supermarkets, becoming Germany's wealthiest person. Now he wants to take on Google, Microsoft and Amazon and an entire region stands to benefit.

entries.title: Ukrainian drone strikes ignite fires at Russian oil sites
entries.snippet: An overnight assault reached key oil facilities in southern Russia, adding pressure to a fuel network already strained by repeated Ukrainian strikes.

entries.title: What's behind Germany's World Cup woes?
entries.snippet: Germany have endured three straight disappointing World Cups. Experts say the reasons why are connected to football, but also to German society.

entries.title: California’s largest lake is turning to dust
entries.snippet: The Salton Sea is drying up, worsening air pollution for people living near its shores. Authorities are working to stabilize the lakebed and lock down the dust. But for some families, it's too late.

entries.title: India news: Prime Minister Modi embarks on maiden trip to New Zealand
entries.snippet: Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi is concluding a tri-country tour with a visit to New Zealand. On his docket are bilateral talks on trade, commerce and defense. DW has more.

entries.title: Iran war: Former supreme leader buried amid new escalation
entries.snippet: Iran buried the late Ayatollah Ali Khamenei following six days of funeral proceedings and amid a renewed escalation. Meanwhile, some tankers continue transiting the Strait of Hormuz. DW has more.

entries.title: Bayeux Tapestry arrives in British Museum for historic exhibition
entries.snippet: After nearly 1,000 years, the medieval masterpiece is back on British soil. The Bayeux Tapestry was transferred from France to London in a highly secretive operation and will be on display in September.

entries.title: Spain battles deadly wildfire amid heat wave
entries.snippet: Spain has mobilized military emergency units to work with regional firefighters to control the blaze. The Spanish royal family and Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez expressed their deep sorrow over the loss of life.

entries.title: UK: Police attempt to remove loyalist bonfire 'hate display'
entries.snippet: A loyalist bonfire in Northern Ireland was lit a day early before police could remove a replica mosque from its top. Political and religious leaders had condemned what organizers insisted was a "political protest."

entries.title: US: Charlie Kirk murder suspect 'regretted' act, roommate says
entries.snippet: Prosecutors in the Charlie Kirk murder case released details from an interview with the suspect's roommate, where he allegedly admitted to the murder and that he regretted it.

entries.title: Mali rebels attack convoy of soldiers, Russian mercenaries
entries.snippet: The convoy was bringing hundreds of personnel in reinforcement in northern Mali, where the Malian army and Russian paramilitaries are fighting jihadist and separatist militants.

entries.title: EU lawmakers pave way for 'digital euro' negotiations
entries.snippet: The digital euro has been touted as the EU's best chance at breaking its dependence on US payment systems like Visa and Mastercard, as well as Apple Pay and Google Pay.

entries.title: Ukraine denies involvement in Nord Stream blasts
entries.snippet: Ukraine's prosecutor general proposed forming a joint investigative team with Germany. Berlin has indicted a former Ukrainian soldier over the blasts and says he was working on behalf of Ukrainian entities.

entries.title: Abbas sets Palestinian legislative elections for November
entries.snippet: The Palestinian Authority has announced it will soon hold its first elections in twenty years. However, questions remain about whether it has the means and legitimacy to do so.

entries.title: South Africa: Driven home by anti-migrant protests
entries.snippet: Two women tell DW how anti-migrant protests upended their lives in South Africa, forcing them to return to Zambia and rebuild from scratch.
